description: End-to-end biosynthetic gene cluster (BGC) analysis of user-provided bacterial genomes: prokka annotation, antiSMASH 7 secondary-metabolite mining with automated database setup, per-genome BGC counts and overview tables, GTDB taxonomy lookup, MIBiG reference table download, BigSCAPE-compatible comparison preparation (symlinks, taxonomy, dataset registry, visualization mapping), and conversion of all result tables into a parquet data warehouse — ready for downstream comparison and exploration.
name: Biosynthetic gene cluster (BGC) genome mining: annotation, antiSMASH and data warehouse
